subject: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI
messages:
From: Sara Collins <sara.collins@catalystai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Catalyst AI is evaluating hosted providers for our next-gen customer service assistant. Can you send your standard per-1M token pricing (separate input vs output if you have different billing), and a current list of hosted models with the baseline rates for each? We'd like a quick, line-item view for: standard Llama-family models, large 70B+ models, and your recommended low-latency options.

Also: we expect ~10M tokens/month initially, with growth toward ~50M over 12 months. Do you provide committed-volume discounts and at what thresholds? Any info on embedding pricing and streaming vs non-streaming rates would also be helpful.

Attaching our RFP and a short context doc.

Thanks,
Sara Collins
Director of ML Infrastructure
Catalyst AI
Attachment: Catalyst_RFP.pdf (pdf)

P.S. Timeline: decision target mid-December, pilot in January if we move forward.
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@catalystai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI

Hi Sara — great to e-meet you. Thanks for the RFP and the context. High-level answers below and I've attached our public rate card for full tables.

Quick bullet summary (hosted API, per 1M tokens):
- Base models (small-medium Llama-family variants): Input $0.25 / 1M tokens, Output $0.35 / 1M tokens
- Mid/large models (70B-ish): Input $1.10 / 1M tokens, Output $1.30 / 1M tokens
- High-capacity / low-latency variants (optimized runtime / reserved capacity): Input $2.75 / 1M tokens, Output $2.75 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (per 1M tokens equivalent): $0.80 / 1M tokens (often quoted per 1K vectors; we can translate on request)

Notes:
- Streaming responses are billed the same per-token as non-streaming; the difference is latency and connection stability (we surface streaming costs in the console).
- We generally separate input vs output for granularity; some customer commitments can flatten to a blended rate.

Attached: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-2026.pdf — includes model catalog and recommended production variants.

For discounts: with a 12-month committed volume we typically propose tiered discounts. For example (indicative): 10M–50M/mo commit -> 15% off list; 50M–200M -> 25% off; 200M+ -> custom pricing and dedicated capacity options. We can firm these up after a short usage profile call.

Could you confirm the following so I can prepare a short proposal?
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens (not just pilot)
- Primary latency SLO (p95 target)
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency / SOC2 / contractual clauses)

If it helps I can put together a one-page pricing proposal for your 10M token baseline tomorrow.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0112
Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-2026.pdf (pdf)
From: Sara Collins <sara.collins@catalystai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Zhou <michael.zhou@catalystai.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI

Thanks Hannah — that's helpful. A couple quick clarifications:
1) For the 10M/month baseline, should we expect blended or separate IO bills on our invoices? We prefer line-item separation for chargebacks to product teams.
2) For embeddings: we will use embeddings for reranking and semantic search (~3–4M vectors/month). Can you convert the $0.80 / 1M tokens equivalent into a per-1K-vector price?
3) Latency: we need p95 < 350ms for short completion (<=128 tokens). Which model/variant do you recommend to meet that without moving to Dedicated right away?

Finally, can you share any standard terms on upfront commit credits vs monthly billing for committed discounts? Our procurement often prefers monthly invoice credits rather than an upfront prepay.

Appreciate the quick turn — decision still targeted for mid-Dec.

Sara

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@catalystai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI

Sara — great questions. Short answers and an attached proposal that shows the math for your 10M/month baseline.

1) Billing: we can invoice with separate line-items for input/output tokens. For customers that prefer simpler chargeback we can provide a blended monthly invoice as well — choice is yours.

2) Embeddings conversion: our $0.80 / 1M tokens is roughly equivalent to $0.10 per 1K vectors for the vector sizes most commonly used for CC/semantic-search. I put the detailed vector pricing table in the attached pdf.

3) Latency: for p95 < 350ms at <=128 tokens we recommend the low-latency variant of our 30B family (quantized + runtime optimizations). That typically hits your p95 in hosted mode without Dedicated, assuming healthy demand shaping. If you need strict p99 SLAs we'd move to a Dedicated pool.

Discounts & billing terms (indicative in-proposal):
- 12-month commitment @ 10M/mo: 15% off list, monthly invoicing with a rolling credit applied (no full upfront required; we can do either).
- 12-month @ 25M/mo: 22% off list, with optional 60-day invoice net.
- 24-month custom: additional 5% off for multi-year.

I've attached a short proposal (Catalyst_Redwood_Pricing_Proposal.pdf) with line-item pricing, example invoices, and a HubSpot link to the draft contract. If this looks good I can schedule a 30-minute call with Ben (solutions lead) tomorrow to validate throughput assumptions and finalize.

Thanks — happy to tighten numbers once you confirm preferred billing cadence.

Best,
Hannah
Attachment: Catalyst_Redwood_Pricing_Proposal.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model list for Catalyst AI

Looping in Lauren from GTM ops — FYI on the proposed discounts. My quick take: for a 12-month, 10M/mo commit we can approve 15% off list with monthly credits. If Catalyst signals 25M+ in the pilot we should move to 22% and fast-track a Dedicated feasibility call.

I'll join the call if Hannah schedules it; Lauren will validate billing/legal flow.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
